statuses.subtitle: Each JIRA status goes to an existing Kompast status or becomes a new one. A new status can get its own column, or join one that already exists.

people.heading: People
people.subtitle: Everyone who touched these issues. Match each person to a Kompast member, or mark them as a former member. Former members keep their name on issues, comments and history, but they have no account and can't sign in.

attachments.heading: Attachments
attachments.subtitle: Files at or under the limit are copied into Kompast. Bigger files stay in JIRA, and the issue links to them.

attachments.stayLine_other: {{count}} files ({{size}}) stay in JIRA. Each issue shows a placeholder with a link.
attachments.imagesNote: Images shown inside descriptions and comments are always copied, whatever their size.

review.subtitle: What the run will do. Nothing is written until you start it.

fields.decimalHint: Kompast story points are whole numbers; 0.5 becomes 1

finish.heading: Finish the migration
finish.intro: Before you finish, check that Kompast matches JIRA. Finishing deletes the JIRA token and turns auto-sync off.

finish.noneYet: No completeness check has run yet.
finish.truncated: {{count}} more differences were not stored with this report.
finish.confirmBody: The JIRA token is deleted and auto-sync turns off. Kompast becomes the place to work.
finish.checkAnnounce: Tell the team the board moved
finish.checkFormer: Former members: {{count}} people were kept as former members. When one joins Kompast, ask an admin to link them.

settingsTab.columnsDescPart1: Column categories define the project's workflow.
settingsTab.columnsDescPart2: and is the only entry point for new issues; other columns can be added, renamed, reordered, or deleted.

settingsTab.deleteColumnConfirm: Delete this column? Its issues will be returned to Backlog.

settingsTab.propertiesDescPart1: These properties form the project's database schema: columns in the Sprint Hub, contents of Kanban cards, and variables automation can use. Add, delete, rename, or change their data type — changes are immediately visible across every view.
settingsTab.deletePropertyConfirm: Delete this property? It will be removed from every issue.
settingsTab.propertiesFooterNote: Core properties can be reordered, but not renamed, retyped, hidden, or deleted.
settingsTab.priorityDesc: Priority levels are shown on every issue and board card. Add, rename, recolor, reorder, or delete them — a level still in use by an issue, or the last one remaining, can't be deleted.
settingsTab.wipHint: Max issues before the column is flagged. Empty = unlimited.
settingsTab.boardBehaviorDesc: Where newly added cards land within a column.
